scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @withmarfa/server run generate:openapi && pnpm --filter @withmarfa/client run generate && pnpm run generate:core
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p ci --noEmit && tsc -p scripts --noEmit
scripts.test:full: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:offline-lane && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test
scripts.test:rust: cd core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run && cd bindings/swift && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run
